title: Knowledge Harness Stage-1 record frontmatter
description: Stage-1 frontmatter object for observation/experiment/evidence records. This project copy is a review copy; records under knowledge/records/ are the only source of truth.
$comment: draft-07. Validates the JSON object produced from restricted TOML frontmatter for OBS/EXP/EVD records only. It cannot express the cross-field invariant ID YYYYMMDD == created; the runtime parser enforces that linkage. It intentionally does NOT and cannot portably enforce: NFKC normalization; calendar validity of dates; created<=updated ordering; UTF-8 byte budgets; array UTF-8-byte sort order (only uniqueness is checked here); the full Unicode general-category (L*/N*) tag rule; symlink escape; path traversal beyond a literal '..' substring; existence/non-self-reference of sources and Contradicts IDs; body heading order and section content; and lifecycle edge legality. Those are enforced by the parser, kh-new, and kh-index policy, never by this schema. No future record types (finding/decision/playbook/failure_pattern/improvement_proposal) are permitted in v1.

items.$comment: Portable ASCII-vs-non-ASCII approximation of the tag policy: allow ASCII lowercase letters and digits, '.', '_', '-', and any non-ASCII character, including astral Unicode scalars; reject ASCII uppercase, whitespace, control chars, and other ASCII punctuation; the first character may not be '.', '_', or '-'. maxLength supplies the <=32 Unicode scalar cap. The stricter policy enforced by the parser (not here) adds NFKC normalization, a <=96 UTF-8 byte cap, exact Unicode L*/N* category checks (with '.', '_', and '-' allowed only after the first scalar), and UTF-8-byte ascending sort order within the array.

sources.$comment: Only EVD or EXP IDs are legal sources (OBS is not a source). Each source ID must exist under the workspace record tree, match its filename and type prefix, and never equal the current record ID. Existence and non-self-reference are enforced by kh-new/kh-index (DANGLING_SOURCE, exit 3), not by this schema. References to refuted or superseded records stay legal so negative history is preserved.

review_by.$comment: Optional review date. When present it must be a non-empty real calendar date. A record whose review_by is earlier than the current date is treated as stale by retrieval; staleness is a runtime comparison, not a stored flag.

supersedes.$comment: Optional. Empty or a non-empty OBS/EXP/EVD ID. Must not equal the current record ID; self-reference and cross-type mismatch are rejected by policy, not here.

superseded_by.$comment: Optional. Empty or a non-empty OBS/EXP/EVD ID. Paired with the successor's supersedes to form a bidirectional supersession link.

artifact_path.$comment: Evidence only. Project-relative path below knowledge/raw/ to the bound artifact: it may not contain a backslash, control char, NUL, empty path segment, '.', or '..'. Every path component must be a regular directory or the final regular file; symlinks are rejected by didim add evidence and didim index (exit 3).

artifact_sha256.$comment: Evidence local / working-tree mode. Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the artifact bytes. kh-index recomputes and compares it (ARTIFACT_DIGEST_MISMATCH, exit 3). Present only in local mode; absent in git mode.

artifact_git.$comment: Evidence git mode. Full 40-hex (SHA-1) or 64-hex (SHA-256) git object ID; the commit plus artifact_path identifies content. Present only in git mode; absent in local mode.

allOf.$comment: ID prefix must match type: observation -> OBS.
Only experiments may use the 'running' status; observation and evidence use draft/validated/refuted/superseded.
Evidence provenance is mandatory: exactly one of local mode (artifact_path + artifact_sha256) or git mode (artifact_path + artifact_git). Non-evidence records must not carry any artifact_* key.
